LeaderHeadInfo.Civilopedia: The feared criminal mastermind known only as the Lady in Black stands at the head of a wide-ranging organized crime network composing multiple Mafia families and international cartels. After bitter infighting between rival Syndicate organizations erupted into a vicious gang war spanning several continents, the Lady accepted an eventual ceasefire giving up control of her Earth criminal empire in exchange for a total monopoly over offworld illegal activity.

Through a series of exquisitely-timed speculations in petrochemical futures, Indonesian real estate, and illegal loans, this ingenious businesswoman has rapidly amassed a fortune of incalculable size. The male-dominated Caliphate ecclesiarchy has grown increasingly dependent on her wide-ranging business interests, yet silently enraged that a shameless usurer (and worse, a female!) can exert such power. As everyone knows, the Sayyadina has legendarily expensive tastes which Earth is increasingly hard-pressed to satisfy - perhaps including a taste for unlimited wealth and power at the head of her own off-world empire.

A prominent scion of one of the many puppet Arab royal families used by the Caliphate government to keep its restless Sunni majority in check, this Cambridge-educated engineer has amassed a small fortune from canny investments skirting the bylaws of Islamic banking. Fearful of his growing support among certain Sunni nationalist elements, the Council of Ayatollahs have quietly forced him to head a seemingly doomed offworld expedition. Will His Highness remain a complacent pet of the Earthbound theocracy, or attempt to found a new royal dynasty amidst the indigo forests of the New Worlds?

The higest levels of Consortium upper management are notoriously secretive. Insulated from criticism by their incalculable wealth and power, many Consortium executives are becoming increasingly detached from the harsh realities of the modern world, periodically issuing naive and eccentric directives that have begun to shake many of the the Consortium's once unassailable monopolies.

The Restored Caliphate dominating much of the Muslim world is governed by a complex hierarchy of mainly Shi'ite Islamic jurists, who maintain a tenuous hold over their diverse population through a combination of apocalyptic preachings and a brutally repressive secret police, the Committee for the Promotion of Virtue and the Prevention of Vice. Ayatollah (from the Arabic ayatul-Lah, or "Sign of God") is a high ranking title given to select Shi‘a clerics. Those who carry the title are considered experts in Islamic studies such as jurisprudence, ethics, and philosophy, and hold considerable power in the Caliphate theocracy. Only a few of the most important ayatollah are accorded the rank of Grand Ayatollah.

A bitter rival of his younger protege, Director Green, this ruthless executive is renowned for his fiery temper and singleminded pursuit of personal wealth. In spite of his generous tranche of stock options, some among the Consortium's upper management have begun to question whether his interests truly align with their own.

Catapulted to upper-level management of the Consortium Space Systems subsidiary following a Machiavellian series of financial maneuverings, this consummate deal-maker masks his burning ambition behind a cool and businesslike veneer.

Believed to be the latest in a line of cyborg prototypes engineered from cutting-edge neurotronics grafted with genetic material from the descendents of the Imperial house, this enigmatic operative rules the Japanese colonies with cold efficiency and a surprisingly deep intuition. It is rumored that he was nearly terminated due to his unprecedented capacity for independent thought, but the continued stagnation of the Empire forced an exodus to the New Worlds in a desperate bid for change. Now free from the confines of the tightly cloistered Japanese islands, perhaps his makers can predict him least of all..

After enforcing ten years of draconian martial law in his former role as Chairman of the puppet Taiwanese Communist Party, this ruthlessly efficient military official barely escaped the purges of the Second Cultural Revolution, and was transferred to a less prestigious post overseeing the PRC's abortive effort at colonizing the New Worlds. Still bitterly resentful of the bureaucrats that engineered his downfall, rumor has it that the Chairman now intends to accumulate an army of his own.

Initially a rising star in Party politics during the CCP's brief period of liberalization, this consummate party functionary quickly fell from favor during the resurgence of the hard-line regime in the aftermath of the Three Gorges Disaster. Her Tibetan ancestry certainly certainly didn't help matters. When most of her faction fell victim to the purge, she was unceremoniously deposed from her post and shipped off on a poorly-manned expedition to the New Worlds that seemed designed to fail. To the Politburo's mixed surprise and chagrin, thus far she has again outperformed everyone's expectations. Some even wonder if she had secretly planned for such an opportunity all along..

This self-absorbed but brilliant scientist was often mocked for his bizarre theories about the extraterrestrial origin of human life, but his undoubted political acumen and a series of groundbreaking breakthroughs kept him moving steadily up the ranks of the EU scientific bureaucracy. Many colleagues were astonished when the discovery of the New Worlds lent sudden credence to the Professor's wildest ramblings; and even more surprised when he gave up a massively influential post as Dean of the University of Vienna to oversee the poorly-funded EU expedition.

Little known outside the circles of the political elite, His Excellency has held a series of vaguely defined but powerful posts in the EU military-industrial bureaucracy. Through highly-placed contacts among the global defense and intelligence communities, he is rumored to have profited immensely from providing high-technology weapons both to covert international terrorist organizations and the governments that suppress them. Enigmatic and unpredictable, His Excellency has again pulled some strings behind the scenes, and now finds himself at the head of a major off-world space operation.

With the all-powerful office of President held by a series of increasingly incompetent media darlings, real power inside the Beltway fluctuates continually among a multitude of lobbyists and interest groups. Exasperated by the growing chaos, this canny military commander has engineered a transfer to the New Worlds in hopes of building a fiefdom of his own.

With NAFTA's Oval Office occupied by a series of ineffectual televangelists and celebrities, the real power lies behind the throne. But with fourteen Cabinet-level assassinations within five years, this is often a dangerous place to be. Whether through prescience or sheer paranoia, this cunning high official has departed Earth for the New Worlds in search of a position of absolute power and safety.

Once among the foremost of Greater Russia's industrial titans, this heavy construction tycoon has sunk much of his considerable personal wealth into controversial investments in offworld industry and resource extraction. For now, the other oligarchs who control the Kremlin are happy to let him play his hand. But with even Siberia's vast resources beginning to dwindle from years of overexploitation, many are beginning to wonder if it was wise to let him take such a large slice of the pie for himself.

This seemingly vapid billionaire heiress has tapped her legendarily wealthy family for seed capital to fund an expedition to the New Worlds, widely seen as a foolish whim held together only by her father's overwhelming power over Russian banking and organized crime. What few people know is that she holds twin degrees in finance and astrophysics, and finds it both amusing and convenient to be chronically underestimated.

Apparently posessing a unique mutation allowing it to perpetually re-enter the seventeen-phase Amphibian life cycle, the being known as Glusk the Moist has reigned over its people's underground ponds for millenia. Retaining only faint conscious memories of past incarnations, Androrc nonetheless appears to wield an almost frightening degree of intuition.

Scholars believe that the near-indestuctible being known as TC01 is a synthetic life form created by a fantastically complex long-ago Progenitor experiment. Centuries old, it has fashioned the race of Silicoids in its own image through fusion of its silicate tendrils with a primitive race of indigenous marsupials.

Believed to be a direct descendant of a line of sector overseers appointed by the Progenitors, this cunning diplomat rules over his fellow Greys through a mix of age-old tradition and Machiavellian intrigue. Originally seventeenth in line to carry the Ashen Sceptre, he is rumored to have systematically disposed of each of his rivals through a complicated series of assassinations and ritual humiliations.

Renowned among his people as a paragon of the traditional Green virtues of wisdom and inscrutability, the subtle Great Elder of the Greens is known to seldom issue a direct command, but makes his wishes known through a complex system of ritual metaphor requiring a separate caste of local priests to interpret his will.

Although bearing little physical resemblance to inaccurate Human reports of Bigfoot sightings, the Sasquatch leader known as Kailric has in fact visited Earth on several occasions over his 700-year lifespan, whether through simple curiosity or a hidden deeper agenda.
Bearing a faint resemblance to the cat deities worshipped by the ancient Egyptians, this cunning predator rules over the nomadic prides of its species with an iron claw.

The first Icthyoid to hatch after each Great Spawning is given the name Dagon, and can often consume seveeral thousand of its embryonic siblings before they hatch, thereby absorbing the strength and wisdom necessary to rule its people for a thousand years. Ancient Earth legends bear numerous references to Dagon as a wise yet monstrous fish-god, a likely testament to long-ago contacts between past Icthyoid spawnings and Earth.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Dagon is sometimes identified with Matsya, the fish avatar of Vishnu, who jumped into the ocean to fight a demon. A statue in Keshava temple in Somnathpur, India depicts Matsya as a fish from the waist down. The fish form may be considered as a phallic symbol as seen in the story of the Egyptian grain god Osiris, whose penis was eaten by (conflated with) fish in the Nile after he was attacked by the Typhonic beast Set. Likewise, in the tale depicting the origin of the constellation Capricornus, the Greek god of nature Pan became a fish from the waist down when he jumped into the same river after being attacked by Typhon.

Some historical sources, such as the Florentine Codex, comment that the ancient Aztecs believed the invading Spaniard Hernan Cortes to be a returned incarnation of the serpent god Quetzalcoatl. Centuries later, great consternation was caused among Earth anthropologists by the discovery of a Reptilian ruler bearing an uncanny resemblance to ancient legends of serpent deities.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The anthropomorphic basis of many myth-systems meant snake-gods were rarely depicted solely as snakes. Exceptions to this were the Fijian creator-god Ndengei, the dozen creator-gods of the Solomon Islands (each with different responsibilities), the Aztec Mother Goddess Coatlicue, and the Voodoo snake-spirits Damballa, Simbi and Petro. Snake-gods were more often portrayed as hybrids or shape-shifters; for example, North American snake-spirits could change between human and serpentine forms whilst keeping the characteristics of both.The most important American snake-god was the Aztec spirit of intelligence and the wind, Quetzalcoatl (Plumed Serpent), who was balanced by the evil spirit of sacrifice, the Serpent of Obsidian Knives which was one of the four pillars supporting the sky. In each case, the association with snakes was based on imagery rather than snake-like qualities. The Mayan sky-goddess was a common attribute. However, in her case, the snakes leaned into her ears and whispered the secrets of the universe (i.e. the secrets of herself). In Indian myth, Shiva had a cobra coiled on his head and another at rest on his shoulder, ready to strike his enemies. Egyptian myth has had several snake-gods, from the 'coiled one' Mehen who assisted Ra in fighting Aapep every day to the two-headed Nehebkau who guarded the underworld.
Although absent for millenia, the Progenitors are held in fear and awe by the natives of the New Worlds, and periodically issue threats and demands from their invisible realm beyond the wormhole.

Assassinated by a North Korean operative in 2027 without a male heir, the brain of Emperor Naruhito was placed in cryogenic suspension; and after a chaotic succession crisis eventually culminating in the Heisei Restoration, was posthumously encoded onto an early artificial intelligence matrix. Although initially a figurehead controlled by METI bureaucrats, this intelligence eventually fused with the various hypercompetent ministerial AIs, and now appears to permeate virtually all aspects of Japanese society.

With growing corruption undermining the rule of law on a global scale, virtually all of Earth's nations are permeated to varying extents by the vast and shadowy criminal organization known as the Syndicate. Syndicate crimelords now exert de facto control over several major metropolitan areas, diverting massive profits from organized crime into the formation of private armies and growing operations in offworld smuggling.
